props.controlled: All members, phase, choices, temperatures, progress, recipe draft, view, offers, results and permissions come from props. No fetch, storage, ticking or optimistic success in the component.
props.choice_contract: Own fixed recipient only; cream/teal; ingredients are 0–3 distinct values from marshmallow/cocoa/cinnamon. Empty means original/plain.
props.input_contract: inputMode is a controller-managed intention: gentle/heat/stir/stop. It is not authoritative progress or a confirmed scene animation.
props.cup_contract: claimed is durable; heldBy is only the currently confirmed in-room holder. Never derive current holding/online state merely from historical claimed=true.

mapping_notes: UI phase is already pouring; no portioning alias is required.
portion maps to finish; swap-stations/toast map to swap/cheers offers; pass responses use the exact cup/offer IDs.
join must map to a real explicit station/join operation, not a local participant insertion.
The controller owns 500ms input renewal and seq; stop must cancel renewal immediately and bypass ordinary pending.
release-input includes the captured sessionId and account for blur, hidden, cleanup and close. Bind it to the correct old lease/generation; late cleanup must not stop a new one.
All confirmed results, makers, real creation dates and toast feedback remain server-owned.

layout.scrolled_panel: Long steps scroll inside the panel; no whole-UI scaling.

checks.scope: Controlled SSR, invitation/input lifecycle and explicitly local rule prototype; not backend/real-session tests.

checks.notes: Project typecheck passed; CocoaPanel is not mounted in App yet. Dedicated prototype bundle includes the component. Shared frontend/dist untouched; existing large-chunk warning remains.
Temporary headless profile, file:// prototype only; no application browser or real DB/uploads.

limitations: READY hands over a controlled component package, not completed server gameplay.
Real two-cookie collaboration, lease/seq/renewal, saves/restarts/idempotency and authority checks belong to the integrator.
Local rule prototype does not emulate authentication, WebSocket, database transactions or network lease expiry.
Application scene placement, artwork, actual actor animation, input blocking via EventBus and real mobile keyboard/safe-area remain unverified here.
No delivery hashes, full regression, real data use, git staging/commit/push, deployment, reset cards or quota purchases.
